content: Yova Kindeni, naneŋgu kazâŋa tamâta sipâŋga kambwaŋenzi rârâ ŋinde! Kinzi simandi ŋana siveta kenzi sakamao pa naŋa.
Kinzi siporo ŋgua ŋana naŋa kâ mine tu, “Maro Kindeni ma ivila i tia.”

Taitu nenzi ŋgua ŋinde nde mao tia. Yova Kindeni, noko kutogo naneŋgu maramuŋa mine. Noko ma kumuŋga pana ŋana apole paraŋa kâ. Noko nâ uru kupu tini kaika pa iloŋgu kaloŋgu, ŋana naŋa akura tu amandi kaika kâ.
Naŋa uru asarâwa pa Yova Kindeni tu ivila naŋa. Aku i imo tamwata ne tuu sapâŋa kulu ku ipaloŋo pa naneŋgu noŋa.
Yova Kindeni uru ikea ŋanana ikura mbo mbo. Mine nde lâ zo ŋana naŋa akeno kenoŋa nia, ande naŋa uru akeno utu lâ lee mbwale pwataki, ŋineŋga amandi sânda kilo.
Kinzi kazâŋa tamâta kambwaŋenzi tamâta-tamâta siŋge naŋa mbwaliu lâ, taitu naŋa ŋandai aruru ŋananzi ŋga.
Yova Kindeni, kumandi ŋga! Naneŋgu Maro Kindeni, kumâ kuvilana! Noko uru kupunzi naneŋgu kazâŋa tamâta rârâni pâta lâ, kala nenzi kaika ŋana sipole naŋa kâ ande ikeno panzi tia.
Yova Kindeni, noko simbo nâ uru kuvilanzi ne tamâta ŋana sipole paraŋa kâ. Noko uru kuveta kie ara nâ panzi tamâta ŋinde sipono muli pano.
